comment: Pinned catalog sources (docs/DOMAIN.md#sources). Change a sha only when deliberately refreshing; then re-run the importer and review REPORT.md.

sources.name: Stats of Atlantis
sources.use: Primary card data (src/new_heroes.json, src/spells.json), hero metadata (src/states.ts), card artwork used to identify card scans

sources.name: GoA2 FAQ
sources.use: Text cross-check (build/data/cards), lore (build/data/heroes.json), FAQ rulings (build/data/faqs), hero portraits (public/hero)

sources.name: colefin8/guards-of-atlantis-ii-data
sources.use: Number cross-check (server/<Hero>.csv; no Ignatia or Whisper)

sources.name: goa2-backend
sources.use: Board maps (src/goa2/data/maps/<map>.json: axial hexes, zones, spawn tags, lanes); corrected in overrides.json (maps) against the official map art

documents.name: Guards of Atlantis II rulebook (2nd printing, web PDF)
documents.use: Rules authority; verbatim excerpts in catalog/rules-reference.json are checked against its text layer (--rules-only)
